361: but the Guru's philosophy is beyond their reach; they cannot find its end. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the Guru's philosophy comes freedom from vices,
ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and the eternal Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the Guru's philosophy the world is saved from vices,
if only a person lends it his love and affection.
But only a rare one brings love and affection to it.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's philosophy there is lasting bliss. ॥2॥
Through the Guru's philosophy the way to freedom from vices is found.
One who takes refuge in the true Guru becomes a support for his family too.
One without a Guru reaches no high spiritual state;
those robbed by their sins suffer the blows of vices. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Through the Guru's word the body finds comfort and peace;
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
having taken the Guru's refuge, no pain can touch him.
Spiritual death does not come near the one who turns to the Guru;
O Nanak, he stays absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥4॥1॥40॥
One who dies to Maya through the Guru's word rids himself of self from within.
One who takes refuge in the true Guru is left without a trace of greed.
The fearless Giver dwells for ever in his mind.
But only a rare one, by good fortune, finds Him through the word of the eternal Lord's praise. ॥1॥
Gather the Lord's virtues within you, and the vices leave your mind.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the perfect Guru's word you will stay absorbed in the Lord of virtues. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who buys the merchandise of the Lord's praise knows its worth;
he repeats the Name through the life-giving word of the Guru.
Through the word of the eternal Lord's praise he becomes pure in life;
through that praise he gains the merchandise of the Name. ॥2॥
The Lord's virtues are beyond price and cannot be bought at any cost;
through the word of the eternal Lord's praise they come to dwell in a purified mind.
Those are fortunate who have meditated on the Name
and enshrined in their minds the Lord who gives the gift of His virtues. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Whoever gathers the Lord's virtues, to them I am a sacrifice.
Staying at the eternal Lord's door, I sing the virtues of the eternal One.
The one to whom the Lord Himself gives this gift dwells in stillness and in love.
O Nanak, the worth of his life cannot be told. ॥4॥2॥41॥
The true Guru has this great virtue,
that he joins to the Lord's feet those separated for many lives.
The Lord Himself brings the Guru, and through the Guru joins them to His feet,
and He Himself creates within them a regard for His Name. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
By what means can regard for the Lord's Name arise in the mind?
ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord is beyond the beyond, unreachable, beyond the senses; only a rare one meets Him through the Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
A rare one, through the Guru's refuge, understands the worth of the Name.
Only a rare one receives it by the Lord's grace.
Through the word of praise of the highest Lord, a person becomes lofty in life.
A rare one, turned to the Guru, repeats the Name through the Guru's word. ॥2॥
Without the Name, the pain and sickness of vices remain in the body;
when one meets the true Guru, that pain is removed.
Without meeting the Guru, a person does only deeds that bring pain,
and so one who follows his own mind keeps receiving heavy punishment. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The Lord's Name is sweet and full of rich savour.
But only the one whom the Lord Himself gives it to drink keeps drinking it.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Only by the Guru's grace does a person enjoy the Lord's essence.
O Nanak, dyed in the Name, a person reaches the high spiritual state. ॥4॥3॥42॥
My beloved Lord is eternal, deep and great of heart.
In remembering Him the body finds comfort and peace.
Those who remember Him through the Guru cross over, and dwell in stillness and in His love;
ਤਿਨ ਕੈ; ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
I fall for ever at their feet. ॥1॥
362: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Those whose minds are dyed through and through with the Lord's love,
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their pain of the round of birth and death is removed, and through love they remain in the Lord's presence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who tastes the Guru's word enjoys a bliss that lasts,
for he keeps the Lord's Name dwelling in his mind.
He sees that the Lord is ever pervading everywhere,
Himself close by every being and Himself far beyond reach. ॥2॥
Everyone says out of habit that the Lord dwells near each one,
but whoever He joins to His feet, He joins by His own grace.
He is not found by speech and talk;
by the Guru's grace He comes to dwell in the mind. ॥3॥
One turned to the Guru rids himself of self from within,
and, dyed in the Lord's love, ends his attachment to Maya.
Reflection on the Guru's word makes a person most pure in life;
O Nanak, joined to the Name, he becomes able to set others' lives right too. ॥4॥4॥43॥
Those absorbed in love of another have earned only pain;
deprived of the Guru's word, they have wasted their lives in vain.
One who walks the way the true Guru shows gains understanding,
and no longer clings to love of Maya. ॥1॥
Those who are joined to the Root, the Creator of the world, are accepted.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਹਰਿ. ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name in the heart at all times, through the Guru's word one comes to know the one Lord deeply. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who clings to the branch, Maya, leaving the Root, goes without fruit.
Caught up in deeds of ignorance, he suffers the punishment of ignorance;
blinded by Maya, one who follows his own mind finds no resting place.
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
He wastes away as a worm of filth in filth. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One who does the service the Guru teaches always enjoys bliss,
for, joining the company of the holy, he keeps singing the Lord's virtues.
Joined to the Name, he always reflects on the Lord's virtues;
so he himself crosses over and becomes able to carry his family across. ॥3॥
One who, joined to the Name, sounds the true Guru's word within,
O Nanak, through the Guru's word, gains a home and dwelling at the Lord's feet.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
One who by the Guru's teaching has bathed in the Lord's Name-water in the pool of the company of the holy
has washed off the filth of an evil mind and rid himself of all sin. ॥4॥5॥44॥
Those who follow their own minds die a spiritual death, and dying, they spoil their death,
for in love of Maya they destroy their spiritual life.
One who follows his own mind is ruined, ever crying "This is mine, this is mine,"
ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ; ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
he never examines his spiritual life, and lies asleep in the wanderings of Maya. ॥1॥
He dies an honourable death who dies to Maya through the Guru's word and stays untouched by attachment;
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ; ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ, ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Guru has made him see praise and slander as alike, and in this life he earns his profit by repeating the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the Name, a person wastes his spiritual life in the round of births,
ever caught in love of Maya, so his life goes in vain.
Without the Name the whole world burns in pain;
but the perfect true Guru has given this understanding to a rare one. ॥2॥
One whose mind wanders restlessly after Maya suffers many blows of attachment.
Having missed his chance in this human life, he finds no place of bliss.
The round of birth and death is a dwelling of filth,
and in that house dwells one who follows his own mind. ॥3॥
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am ever a sacrifice to my own true Guru.
The Guru merges the attention of one who takes his refuge into the Lord's light.
Through the Guru's pure word one finds a home in his own true self, at the Lord's feet;
O Nanak, he ends his pride and stays ever detached from Maya. ॥4॥6॥45॥
The servant has wiped out his separate existence;
363: he hands his body and mind to the Guru and takes the Guru's refuge.
His greatest honour is that he keeps the Name in his heart,
of the Lord who is beloved of all and the friend of all. ॥1॥
The real servant is the one who, doing the world's work, is dead to the world's desires;
ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ. ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he holds sorrow and joy alike, and by the Guru's grace, joined to the word, he is saved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
From His presence the Lord has told His servant the work to do: remembering Him.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਕੋ. ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without the Guru's word no one is accepted at His door.
So the servant sings His praise and keeps His Name in mind; this is the work he has to do.
The Lord Himself gives this gift, and wastes no time in giving. ॥2॥
The world that follows its own mind goes astray in the wandering of Maya,
like a trader who, without capital, deals only in fraud.
ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ; ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
One with no capital cannot obtain the goods;
so one who follows his own mind, gone astray, wastes his life. ॥3॥
The real servant is the one who takes refuge in the true Guru;
he becomes high in standing and noble in life,
ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ; ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
and leaning on the ladder the Guru gives, he rises above all.
O Nanak, honour lies in remembering the Lord's Name. ॥4॥7॥46॥
The soul-bride who follows her own mind always does what is of no use to her spiritual life;
ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
by such efforts she never finds the Master's dwelling.
Caught in love of Maya, she goes astray in its wandering.
Bound by possessiveness, the world keeps coming and going. ॥1॥
O mind, look at the adornment of the wife her Husband has left: it is all show and vice.
ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ, ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So too, whoever sets his heart on sons, wife, wealth and Maya, all his attachment is false, mere show and vice. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The soul-bride who pleases the Lord is for ever fortunate.
Through the Guru's word she makes union with the Lord her adornment;
the bed of her heart becomes a comfort, for at all times she enjoys union with her Husband;
meeting her Beloved, she always enjoys bliss. ॥2॥
ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
That soul-bride is fortunate for good whose love is for the eternal Lord;
ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
she keeps her Husband ever enshrined in her heart,
she sees Him always near, always beside her,
and sees my beloved Lord pervading all. ॥3॥
In the world beyond, neither high caste nor beauty goes with us.
As are the deeds a person does here, so his life becomes.
The higher and higher a person rises through the Guru's word,
O Nanak, the more he is absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥4॥8॥47॥
One dyed in devotion to the Lord dwells in stillness and is rapt in His love;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
in awe of the Guru and of the eternal Lord, he merges in the eternal Lord.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the perfect Guru's refuge there is no devotion;
those who follow their own minds lose their honour and repent in the end. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O my mind, recall the Lord's virtues and meditate on Him always.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ. ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever repeats the Name has joy within him day and night, and gains whatever fruit he desires. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only from the perfect Guru is the Lord, master of all virtues, found;
one who takes his refuge enshrines in his heart the Guru's word and the eternal Name,
and as he bathes in the pool of life-giving Name-water, his heart grows pure.
Absorbed in the eternal Lord, people become pure for ever. ॥2॥
One who repeats the Name sees the Lord always present beside him;
by the Guru's grace he sees Him pervading everywhere.
The Guru has been gracious to me too: wherever I go, I see only Him.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
But no one other than the Guru can give this gift. ॥3॥
The Guru is an ocean, and his treasure is inexhaustible,
full of countless precious jewels and gems of the Lord's praise.
Through the Guru's grace the Lord, the Giver, gives these jewels of praise.
O Nanak, the Forgiver grants His forgiveness and gives these treasures. ॥4॥9॥48॥
The Guru is an ocean of virtues, the very form of the eternal Lord;
only by great fortune can one do the service the Guru teaches.
364: He alone understands this secret whom the Lord Himself makes understand,
and by the Guru's grace the Lord has him do His service and devotion. ॥1॥
Through the jewel of knowledge the Guru gives, a person gains every kind of understanding of the right way to live.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ, ਵੇਖੈ, ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One whose ignorance is dispelled by the Guru's grace stays awake to Maya's attacks at all times and sees the eternal Lord everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who burns away attachment and pride through the Guru's word,
who learns the right way to live from the perfect Guru,
recognises through the Guru's word the Lord's dwelling within himself;
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ; ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
his coming and going ends, and dwelling in the Name he becomes steady of mind. ॥2॥
For one who follows his own mind, the world is only the round of birth and death.
One who follows his own mind is heedless of the Lord, and the pitch darkness of attachment to Maya blinds him.
He always slanders others and practises nothing but falsehood and deceit,
ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
and stays in it as a worm of filth stays in filth. ॥3॥
One who gains all true understanding by joining the company of the holy,
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
who holds the Guru's word in his heart and makes devotion to the Lord firm within,
who accepts the Lord's will as sweet, is always at peace;
O Nanak, he stays absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥4॥10॥49॥
One who dies to Maya through the Guru's word has lasting bliss.
One who takes refuge in the true Guru leans on the Lord, the Guru of the world;
ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
he does not die the spiritual death again, nor keep coming and going.
By the perfect Guru's grace he stays absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Those on whose foreheads the Lord has written from the start the decree of remembering the Name,
ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they meditate on the Name at all times, and from the perfect Guru receive the mark of devotion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Those whom the Lord joins to His feet,
ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
their deep spiritual state cannot be described.
Those to whom the perfect true Guru gave this honour of being joined to His feet
gained the highest state, and stay absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
"Whatever is done, the Lord Himself does;
in a moment He can create and destroy."
One who only says this again and again to others,
ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ; ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
even if he labours a hundred times so, none of it is accepted at the Lord's door. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Those who carry good impressions of past deeds, the Lord brings to meet the Guru;
the Guru recites to them the word of praise and the eternal Lord's Name.
ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ; ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
In the heart where the Guru's word dwells, all pain departs.
Through the jewel of knowledge the Guru gives, a person stays merged in the eternal Lord and in stillness. ॥4॥
ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ; ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
There is no wealth equal to the Lord's Name,
but it comes only to the one on whom the eternal Lord Himself bestows it.
Through the perfect Guru's word he keeps the Name dwelling in his mind.
O Nanak, dyed in the Name, a person enjoys bliss. ॥5॥11॥50॥
If a person dances as worship and plays many instruments,
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
he tells it to no one, for his own mind is blind and deaf to Maya.
Within him are greed and wandering, like fire and wind;
the lamp of knowledge cannot burn, and he gains no understanding. ॥1॥
Through devotion done while turned to the Guru, light dawns in the heart.
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ; ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through it a person keeps examining his own spiritual life, and meets the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Staying turned to the Guru is the true dance; so love for the Lord is formed.
Ridding oneself of self from within is dancing perfectly in time.
The eternal Lord Himself becomes the friend of one who dances this way,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
and through the Guru's word the Lord dwelling within becomes known to him. ॥2॥
Through devotion done while turned to the Guru, love and affection arise within.
The Guru's word brings a person into stillness and gives reflection on the Lord's virtues.
Devotion done while turned to the Guru is the right way by which that eternal Lord is met.
The dance of devotion done for show brings only pain. ॥3॥
365: True devotion is this: that a person, while doing the world's work, stays untouched by attachment to Maya,
and by the Guru's grace crosses the world-ocean of vices.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Devotion done by the Guru's teaching is accepted at the Lord's door,
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ; ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
and God Himself comes to dwell in that person's mind. ॥4॥
On whomever God shows mercy, He brings that one to the Guru.
ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
With the Guru's help he practises unwavering devotion and keeps his mind joined to God.
Those dyed in devotion receive glory that lasts for ever.
O Nanak, those dyed in the Name find spiritual bliss. ॥5॥12॥51॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
By God's will the true Guru is met; then the eternal Lord is found and right understanding comes.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
The one in whose mind God comes to dwell by the Guru's grace, he alone becomes one with God. ॥1॥
ਮੈ. ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
One God alone is my Master and protector, giver of all gifts; I have no one else besides Him.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only by the Guru's mercy does He dwell in the mind, and then there is bliss for ever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ, ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
In this world God's Name alone saves from every fear, but it is found through the Guru's teaching.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Without the Name, the soul-bride who follows her own mind stays in the grip of spiritual death, blinded by Maya and foolish. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Whoever walks in God's will, he alone serves God and understands the eternal Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Only by walking in God's will can He be praised; by obeying His will spiritual bliss is gained. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
Whoever, walking in God's will, has gained the aim of human birth, his intellect has become noble.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
O Nanak, you too praise the Name; through the Guru the high spiritual state is reached. ॥4॥39॥13॥52॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
You are the Creator, the eternal One, and my Master.
ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ; ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ. ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever pleases You comes to pass; I gain only what You give me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the world is Yours, and all beings have remembered You alone.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨਿ. ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The one on whom You show mercy has found the jewel of Your Name.
One who turns to the Guru found it; one who follows his own mind lost it.
You Yourself have kept one apart from You, and You Yourself have joined the other to You. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ; ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
You are the great river of life, and all creation lives within You;
apart from You there is no other being at all.
All these creatures are Your play.
By separation ordained a united being is parted, and by union ordained he meets again. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ. ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
The one to whom You give understanding, he alone understands life's aim,
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
and he ever speaks and tells of God's virtues.
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Whoever served God in devotion has enjoyed spiritual bliss;
resting in stillness of mind, he has merged in God. ॥3॥
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
You Yourself are the Creator; all that happens is Your doing,
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
and besides You there is no other doer.
ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Having made it, You Yourself care for all, and You alone know the whole secret.
O servant Nanak, to one who faces the Guru this whole matter becomes clear. ॥4॥1॥53॥
366: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
One person has made a bond with his friend, son and brother;
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ. ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
another has formed a faction with his own in-laws and his son-in-law;
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ. ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
another, for his own ends, has formed a faction with the village headman and chief;
but my ally is God, who is present everywhere. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
I have made God my ally; God alone is my support.
ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ. ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Apart from God I have no side and no faction; I sing the countless, endless virtues of God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Those with whom people form factions depart from the world,
and the faction-makers, after this false show, grieve when they die.
ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
They themselves do not stay for ever, yet they keep plotting deceit in their minds.
ਹਮ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
I have made my ally God, whose equal in power there is none. ॥2॥
ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
All these factions are the spread of Maya and attachment.
Foolish people fight one another for Maya alone.
They are born and die again and again, losing the game of human life as if at gambling.
ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ; ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
But my ally is God, who sets right this world and the next. ॥3॥
ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ; ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
Parted from God, in the dark age's nature, people form factions, and the five thieves stir up quarrels;
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
separation from God makes lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride grow within them.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
On whom God shows mercy, He joins him to the company of the holy.
ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
My help is God Himself, who has ended all these factions within me. ॥4॥
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ; ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
False love of Maya, taking hold within, creates factions.
ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ; ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
A person then searches out others' faults and swells his own pride.
As he sows, so he reaps.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ. ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ; ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
Servant Nanak's ally is God, and God's support is his dharma, by which one can win over the whole world. ॥5॥2॥54॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
One who, hearing the Guru's word, comes to love in his heart the Name that gives spiritual life,
through the Guru's word beholds the unseen God. ॥1॥
O my sisters, turn to the Guru and listen to the Name of that God
ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ. ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who alone pervades every body; with your mouth speak the Guru's life-giving words. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੈ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
Love for God has arisen in my mind and heart, and a great longing for Him,
for I too have met the true Guru, God's own form, the one of great fortune. ॥2॥
Those who, caught in love of Maya, wander after Maya, the poison of spiritual death,
are unfortunate, for they have not met the Guru. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
The one to whom God Himself has given the life-giving essence of His Name to drink,
O Nanak, has found God through the perfect Guru. ॥4॥3॥55॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
God's love and God's Name are the support of my mind and heart.
I keep repeating the Name; the Name is the essence of all comforts for me. ॥1॥
O my friends and companions, repeat God's Name.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name I see no other support; this Name is gained by great fortune through the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without repeating God's Name, spiritual life cannot be had.
By great fortune God is found through the Guru. ॥2॥
Without the Name, love of Maya blackens the face,
and without the Name, life is accursed, accursed. ॥3॥
367: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ; ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
By great fortune one meets God, the greatest of all,
O Nanak, the one to whom He gives the gift of His Name through the Guru. ॥4॥4॥56॥
I too sing God's virtues and utter the word of His praise;
turning to the Guru, I keep speaking and telling of God's virtues. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Repeating the Name again and again, joy arises in the mind.
ਸਤਿ. ਸਤਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ; ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ, ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one in whose heart the true Guru has fixed the true Name, true Name, began to sing with love the virtues of God, the supreme bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
and by great fortune he meets God, the One untouched by Maya. ॥2॥
Those without His praise keep the filth of love of Maya in their minds.
Without His praise, those swollen with pride are born and die again and again. ॥3॥
In the pool of this body the Guru has revealed God's virtues.
O Nanak, as butter is churned from milk, one who turns to the Guru reflects again and again and draws out life's essence. ॥4॥5॥57॥
I keep hearing the Name, and the Name alone is dear to my mind.
By great fortune one who turns to the Guru gains God's Name. ॥1॥
Turning to the Guru, repeat the Name, and the light of a higher spiritual life will dawn within.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name I see no other support, so I remember the Name with every breath and every morsel. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Ever since I heard the tidings of the Name, it has been dear to my mind.
ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Whoever recites the Name to me, he is my friend and companion. ॥2॥
Fools without the Name depart from here empty-handed,
ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
and as the moth perishes seeing the flame, they wither in Maya's poison and die a spiritual death. ॥3॥
The God who Himself creates the world, and having created, destroys it too,
O Nanak, Himself gives the gift of His Name. ॥4॥6॥58॥
Those who turn to the Guru have made the vine of God's Name grow within them,
and it bears the sweet fruits of spiritual virtues. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
Remember the Name of God, Lord of endless waves of creatures.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ. ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeat the Name again and again by the Guru's teaching and praise Him; whoever does so has killed the snake of the mind, the fear of death and Death's messengers. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
O my brother, God has placed His devotion in the Guru,
ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
and the Guru, when pleased, gives this gift to the Sikh. ॥2॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who does religious deeds in pride knows nothing at all of devotion.
ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ; ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
His deeds are like an elephant that bathes and then throws dust on its head. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
If one's fortune is great, if it is very high,
O Nanak, such people repeat the Name and, joined to the eternal Lord, become pure of life. ॥4॥7॥59॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
O my brother, a hunger for God's Name stays in my mind.
ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ. ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
By hearing the Name the mind stays sated of Maya, O my brother. ॥1॥
O my friends, the Guru's Sikhs, keep repeating the Name.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ. ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ, ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeat the Name, find spiritual bliss in the Name, and by the Guru's teaching keep the Name in your mind and heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Hearing the Name and only the Name, the mind stays green with virtues.
Earning the profit of the Name by the Guru's teaching, the mind stays glad. ॥2॥
Without the Name a person writhes like a leper with spiritual diseases, blinded by attachment to Maya.
ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ; ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
All the deeds he does are fruitless; they bring only pain and the snare of Maya. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Fortunate is he who ever sings God's praise.
O Nanak, by the Guru's teaching the mind stays attuned to the Name. ॥4॥8॥60॥
368: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
The yogi holds the instrument in his hand and plays its string, but it sounds to no effect.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
O yogi, by the Guru's teaching speak God's virtues, and this stubborn mind is drenched in God's love. ॥1॥
O yogi, teach your mind the wisdom of remembering God's Name.
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In every age God alone does all, and before Him I bow my head. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ. ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ, ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
Yogis sing ragas and utter many kinds of words, but this stubborn mind keeps playing other games.
ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ. ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ; ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
It is like yoking the well to water the field, while one's own oxen get up and graze the vines. ॥2॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ. ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ, ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
O yogi, sow the deeds of remembering God in this body-town, and a green field of God's Name springs up.
ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
Steady the mind, yoke this steadied mind as the ox, and water yourself with God's Name by the Guru's teaching. ॥3॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ; ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
Yogis, wandering ascetics and all creation are Yours; whatever wisdom You give, that way they go.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
O inner-knowing Lord of servant Nanak, prompt our minds and join them to Your feet. ॥4॥9॥61॥
ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ. ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ; ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
Why should anyone search for ankle bells to keep time, why should anyone play the rebab?
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Some time is spent coming and going to fetch them; for that long I would remember the Name. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Such devotion has taken shape in my mind
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ. ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that I cannot live a moment without remembering God, as a fish dies without water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਬ ਕੋਊ. ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ; ਕਬ ਕੋ. ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
Why should anyone tune five strings and seven notes to sing, why should anyone raise the strain of a raga?
ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ, ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ, ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Tuning and raising them takes some moments; for that long my mind would sing the Lord's virtues. ॥2॥
ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ; ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
Why should anyone dance, spreading out the feet, why should anyone spread out the hands?
ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ, ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Spreading hands and feet takes a little while; for that long my mind would keep the Lord in the heart. ॥3॥
ਕਬ ਕੋਊ, ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ; ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ, ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Why should anyone try to convince people? Even if people are satisfied, no honour comes at the Lord's door.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
O servant Nanak, ever remember God in your heart, and then everyone honours you. ॥4॥10॥62॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
One should join the company of the holy, the Guru's company; joining it, keep singing God's virtues.
ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ. ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
The jewel of wisdom shines, the heart is lit, and the darkness of ignorance departs. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O servants of God, dance by remembering God's Name.
ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my brother, if I meet such saints, I would wash their feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my mind, repeat God's Name, keeping your attention fixed on God day after day,
ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
and whatever fruit you wish for you will gain, and the hunger for Maya will never come back. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
The boundless Creator Himself speaks in all, and Himself moves beings to speak.
ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ, ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ. ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
O Lord, those alone are good and saintly who please You, whose honour is accepted at Your door. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ, ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ; ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Nanak is never sated with telling God's virtues; the more he praises Him, the more spiritual bliss he finds.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ. ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ. ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
God has given the treasures of His devotion, but only the buyer of virtues trades and takes them along. ॥4॥11॥63॥
369: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ, ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Asa Kafi · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 8
Death comes as a decree from the very first; it is through pride that we weep.
Turning to the Guru and remembering the Name, one becomes steady of mind. ॥1॥
Those who learned through the perfect Guru that they must depart have won acclaim.
ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ, ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They earned the Name, the finest profit, and stayed merged through the Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ; ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
O mother, those given days by what was written before come into the world;
ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲੑਿ; ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
and from the first the order is given that they must leave today or tomorrow. ॥2॥
ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Wasted is the human birth of those who have forgotten the Name.
ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ; ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
They played a game of gambling in the world and lost this mind to the vices. ॥3॥
ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those who have found the Guru know bliss in living and comfort in dying,
for, O Nanak, they stay merged in the eternal Lord and become one with Him. ॥4॥12॥64॥
Those who, gaining the precious human birth, remembered the Name,
understood its worth by the Guru's grace and merged in the eternal Lord. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ; ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Those alone have earned the Name on whose foreheads that writ was written from the first.
ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ; ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They are honoured at the eternal Lord's door and called into His presence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The treasure of the Name is within everyone, but it is found by turning to the Guru.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
So let us remember the Name day after day and sing God's virtues. ॥2॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The Name and countless virtues lie within, but one who follows his own mind finds nothing.
Through pride he keeps vaunting himself, and so he himself stays parted from God. ॥3॥
O Nanak, such a one always parts himself from God by his own doing.
By the Guru's teaching the mind is lit and the eternal Lord is found. ॥4॥13॥65॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ ॥
Asavari Sudhang · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 16
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Day and night I repeat God's Name and sing His praise.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Since the true Guru told me of God's Name, I cannot live a moment without remembering God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ. ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
Hearing God's praise and remembering His Name are my wealth; without God I cannot live for a single moment.
ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ. ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ, ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can God's servant live without serving God? ॥1॥
ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ, ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ; ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
Some have set love on Maya, holding it in their hearts; some have set love on attachment and pride.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ, ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
But God's servants have set love on God and enjoy the state free of craving, O Nanak, ever remembering God. ॥2॥14॥66॥
ਮਾਈ. ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ; ਬਤਾਵਹੁ. ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O mother, tell me, where is my beloved Lord?
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot live a moment without Him; seeing Him I am glad as a young camel is glad seeing vines. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
My mind has grown restless and detached from the world for the sight of God, my friend.
ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ. ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਤੈਸੇ. ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, so I cannot live without God. ॥1॥
370: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
O Lord of the world, O beloved, O Lord of the earth, keep me in Your refuge and fulfil this longing of mine.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ. ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
When You are seen, joy wells up in the mind of Your servant Nanak; O Lord, grant me Your sight even for the blink of an eye. ॥2॥39॥13॥15॥67॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Whoever set his love on Maya was in turn devoured by her.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Whoever seated her beside him with honour, to him she showed great fear.
Brothers, friends and family fall to quarrelling at the sight of her.
By the Guru's grace she has come under our control. ॥1॥
Seeing her, all these are utterly intoxicated:
ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ. ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
seekers, adepts, gods and men; apart from the Guru, all are cheated by the cheat, Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Many wander as renunciants, yet she overpowers them in the form of lust.
ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
Some gather her as householders, yet she never becomes their own.
ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
Many call themselves givers of charity, and she torments them greatly too.
ਹਮ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Because we clung to the true Guru's feet, God has saved us. ॥2॥
She has led astray the ascetics practising austerities.
All the learned pandits, caught in greed, have been cheated.
All beings of the three qualities are being cheated, and the gods too.
ਹਮ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
The true Guru has saved us by giving us his hand. ॥3॥
For one who has formed a deep bond with God, she works as a servant;
she joins her palms before him, serves him and pleads with him,
ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ; ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
saying, "I will do whatever work you tell me.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ; ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
O servant Nanak, I will not come near the one who takes the Guru's refuge." ॥4॥1॥
The Husband has set me apart from my mother-in-law, ignorance;
my sisters-in-law, hope and craving, have died of grief and anguish.
ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ; ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Even the elder brother-in-law, the righteous judge, no longer holds sway over me.
My wise and skilful Husband has saved me from them all. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ; ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Listen, people: I have tasted the joy of God's love.
ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The true Guru has given me the Name of God; through it I have killed my evil inclinations and destroyed my enemies. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
First, I gave up loving pride;
second, I gave up the customs of the world;
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
then, leaving Maya's three qualities, I came to see enemy and friend alike.
Meeting the Guru, I came to know the quality that lifts one to the fourth spiritual state. ॥2॥
I have set my seat in the cave of stillness of mind.
Within me the unbroken music of union with God, who is pure light, has begun to play.
Reflecting on the Guru's word, great bliss wells up within me.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ; ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Blessed and fortunate is the soul-bride dyed in her Husband's love. ॥3॥
Servant Nanak speaks only of reflection on God's virtues.
ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Whoever hears it and lives by it crosses over.
ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He is not born and does not die; he neither comes nor goes.
He remains absorbed in remembrance of God. ॥4॥2॥
Devotion that serves the soul is like a wife of sweet nature,
matchless in beauty and perfect in conduct.
ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
The heart in which she dwells becomes a home of glory,
but rare is the one who has won her by taking the Guru's refuge. ॥1॥
ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, I have gained a wife of noble deeds,
